```{r setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

```{r Import }

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M5_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../../raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_lo_05.sas7bdat")


```

# id_01_lo_05

## Corriger données d'identité

```{r M5_A0 to M5_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M5_A1 <- M5_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  ))

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M5_A2 <- M5_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M5_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(lo_type:id_age_cat_3))

```

## Travailler sur les colonnes
### Renommer et réordonner

```{r M5_A2 to M5_B0}

vars_sub_la <- M5_A2 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("la_"))) %>% 
  colnames()

M5_B0 <- M5_A2 %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("^la_", "lo_", .x), all_of(vars_sub_la)) %>% 
  rename("lo_commentaires" = "commentaires_loge",
         "lo_dep_centre1" = "dep_centre1",
         "lo_statut_occup" = "lo_occup_logement",
         "lo_statut_occup_autre" = "lo_occup_logement_autre",
         "lo_dep_situ_centre1" = "dep_la_situ_centre1") %>% 
  relocate(c("lo_date_creation", "lo_an_logement",
             "lo_situ_logement", "lo_situ_dep", "lo_dep_situ_centre1", "lo_situ_pays"),
           .after = id_age) %>% 
  relocate(lo_dep_situ_centre1, .after = lo_dep_centre1) %>%
  relocate(c("lo_type_logement", "lo_type_logement_autre", "lo_statut_occup",
             "lo_statut_occup_autre", "lo_occup_cause_1", "lo_occup_cause_2",
             "lo_occup_cause_3", "lo_occup_cause_999", "lo_occup_cause_autre",
             "lo_amenag_logement", "lo_amenag_logement_precis", "lo_emprunt_1",
             "lo_emprunt_2", "lo_emprunt_3", "lo_emprunt_4", "lo_emprunt_5",
             "lo_emprunt_6", "lo_emprunt_precis", "lo_demenag", "lo_demenag_cause_1",
             "lo_demenag_cause_2", "lo_demenag_cause_999", "lo_demenag_cause_autre"),
           .after = lo_dep_situ_centre1) %>% 
  relocate(lo_commentaires, .after = last_col()) %>% 
  select(-fa_amenag) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_age, .after = last_col())

rm(vars_sub_la)
```

### Identifier absents

```{r M5_B0 to M5_B1}

vars_check <- M5_B0 %>%
  select(lo_an_logement:lo_situ_pays, lo_type_logement:lo_demenag_cause_autre) %>%
  names()

M5_B1 <- M5_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    lo_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  
  # Ajouter petit changement unique
  mutate(
    lo_dep_centre1 = replace_when(
      lo_dep_centre1,
      id_anonymat == "WUJIE" ~ -8L
    )
  )

```

## Travailler sur les lignes

### Retirer les doublons

```{r M5_B1 to M5_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M5_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>% 
  fill(lo_dep_centre1:lo_dep_situ_centre1, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(lo_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M5_C0 <- M5_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

```

## Export de la base avant le recodage

```{r}

write_csv(M5_C0, "../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M5_C0.csv")

rm(list = c("M5_A0", "M5_A1", "M5_A2", "M5_B0", "M5_B1", "M5_C0", "vars_check",
            "doublons", "doublons_corr"))
```

# logement_05

```{r}

M5_S0 <- haven::read_sas("../../../raw_data/gb_ddb_logement_05.sas7bdat")

```

## Corriger les doublons

```{r M5_S0 to M5_S2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M5_S1 <- M5_S0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -lo_type, -tab_db, -fa_amenag) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  ))

# Identifier les doublons

doublons <- M5_S1 %>% 
  filter(id_anonymat == id_doublon) 

doublons_corr <- doublons %>% 
  select(-id_anonymat, id_anonymat = id_keep) %>% 
  mutate(id_keep = id_anonymat) %>% 
  relocate(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep)

M5_S2 <- M5_S1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_anonymat %in% doublons$id_anonymat) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr"))
```

## Renommer et réordonner

```{r M5_S2 to M5_T0}
vars_sub_la <- M5_S2 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("la_"))) %>% 
  colnames()

M5_T0 <- M5_S2 %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("^la_", "lo_", .x), all_of(vars_sub_la)) %>% 
  rename("lo_commentaires" = "commentaires_loge",
         "lo_statut_occup" = "lo_occup_logement",
         "lo_statut_occup_autre" = "lo_occup_logement_autre") %>% 
  relocate(c("lo_date_creation", "lo_an_logement",
             "lo_situ_logement", "lo_situ_dep", "lo_situ_pays"),
           .after = id_keep) %>% 
  relocate(c("lo_type_logement", "lo_type_logement_autre", "lo_statut_occup",
             "lo_statut_occup_autre", "lo_occup_cause_1", "lo_occup_cause_2",
             "lo_occup_cause_3", "lo_occup_cause_999", "lo_occup_cause_autre",
             "lo_amenag_logement", "lo_amenag_logement_precis", "lo_emprunt_1",
             "lo_emprunt_2", "lo_emprunt_3", "lo_emprunt_4", "lo_emprunt_5",
             "lo_emprunt_6", "lo_emprunt_precis", "lo_demenag", "lo_demenag_cause_1",
             "lo_demenag_cause_2", "lo_demenag_cause_999", "lo_demenag_cause_autre"),
           .after = lo_situ_pays) %>% 
  relocate(lo_commentaires, .after = last_col()) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = last_col())

rm(vars_sub_la)
```

## Identifier les absents

```{r}

vars_check <- M5_T0 %>%
  select(lo_an_logement:lo_demenag_cause_autre) %>%
  names()

M5_T1 <- M5_T0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    lo_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  filter(lo_complet == 1)

```
